name: 06269 · Storrs, CT
findings: ZIP 06269 (Storrs) has 37 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (62%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (69% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06269 (Storrs) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 06269 (Storrs) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 47% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
